summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WebSocket enhancement for Pakistan Intelligence Monitor dashboard. All backend APIs working (28/28 tests passed). Frontend WebSocket real-time functionality working correctly with LIVE/POLLING status indicators, viewer count, and fallback mechanisms.
passed_tests: Backend API /api/health returns 200 with healthy status
Backend API /api/ws-status returns WebSocket status with connected_clients, ws_path, events
All data APIs (news, economic, security, weather) return correct data
Frontend loads and shows 'LIVE' status with green dot when WebSocket connected
Frontend shows viewer count next to LIVE indicator
PAKISTAN tab shows all panels: map, briefing, news, economic, inflation
ENERGY tab shows energy news, power generation, energy payments
WebSocket connection remains stable during testing
Tab switching works with WebSocket active
WebSocket uses polling transport as fallback
Background push loop sends expected events (news_update, security_update, weather_update, energy_news_update)
Polling interval adjusts based on WebSocket connection status (60s → 5min when connected)
